state_model.canonical_serialization: JSON with sorted object keys and deterministic array ordering

transition.rule: Apply the structural transformation profile z[selected_action] to S_t using the domain/operationalisation-specific deterministic transition operator.

realized_transformation.definition: The deterministic structural change applied by the selected action under z.

t_acc.definition: The set of transformations accessible from the resulting successor state under the frozen domain/operationalisation transition rules.
t_acc.derivation: Enumerate the deterministic candidate transformations available from S_t_plus_1 and retain only structurally valid transitions.

pre_decision_boundary: No transition output or T_acc value may enter the decision input.
